intro: Bloom of the Heavens concerns the recovery of Nord'el, a sacred night elf flower gathered under a full moon on Mount Hyjal. The flower was lost when the night elf vessel Flying Osprey wrecked south of Menethil Harbor alongside ships of the Kul Tiran Third Fleet, leaving its retrieval in the hands of adventurers brave enough to face the murlocs nesting among the ruins.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I came to Menethil Harbor from Auberdine, from the great tree Teldrassil, to recover a bloom of great import to my people.

My people's ship the Flying Osprey crashed here many moons ago, joined with the Kul Tiran Third Fleet. Among its cargo was the flower known as Nord'el--Bloom of the Heavens in your tongue--bloomed under a full moon at the peak of Mount Hyjal, our former home.
Please help me retrieve it! The wreckage is just south of the city, but it is inhabited by fierce murloc raiders!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you been to the wreckage? It is a most somber sight.
